published_title: Let the Wookie Agents Win      Cause They Get No Love
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Xavier Six''') posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.

starting.card: Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire

description: Once again, another theme deck thats just plain fun. I've played this deck around a bit and it does surprisingly well even against monsters like Hunt Down. That and wookies are just cool.
cards: Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire
Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & •Out Of Somewhere
Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice
posted: Let the Wookie Win x 2
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire, Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Yarna d'al' Gargan, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Uh-oh!, 'Staging Areas(or Ounee Ta)' and Insurrection; these count toward the 60.
The starting section also reads '(Rep = Chewbacca)'; the representative is one of the three Chewbacca listed under Characters, so it has no row of its own (the sections then add up to 8 + 52 = 60).
Posted 'Staging Areas(or Ounee Ta)' is kept as written (one line naming two choices); Staging Areas is the listed default, and Ounee Ta also appears under Effects.
Posted 'DB 97' matches no card and is kept as written; it is most likely a typo for Tatooine: Docking Bay 94.
Posted 'POS x 2' dested Projection Of A Skywalker, the Light Jabba's Palace Effect (the only Light Effect of that era with those initials; posted under Effects).

Posted 'Obi with LS' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia With Blaster' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han with Blaster' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (the Jabba's Palace 'with' versions, alongside Luke With Lightsaber and Lando With Vibro-Ax); 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Let The Wookiee Win is an Interrupt, posted under Effects.
The post ends: 'Stupid computer... didn't mean to have this posted twice.'; no second copy of this list was found among the DeckTech posts.
